observations: A light purple or lavender PlayStation 5 console is shown in a vertical, open-back position.
A matching light purple DualSense wireless controller is placed in front of the console.
The background consists of a wall of stacked DVDs or Blu-rays.
A watermark 'HYMAN GADGETS HUB' and 'VIDEO ON JIJI' is visible across the center of the image.
The console's disc drive is visible on the left side.
The console appears to be a custom or third-party skin rather than the official PlayStation branding.

claims.evidence: The origin cannot be confirmed from a photo of the console.
The controller is shown, but the 'accessories' claim is vague and not fully demonstrated.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from PlayStation Network (PSN) or have a blacklisted serial number.
risks.proof: A photo of the console's system information screen showing the serial number and the 'PSN Status' as 'Online' or 'Online (Banned)'.
risks.if_unproven: as a banned or non-functional unit

risks.risk: The console may have internal hardware faults or a faulty disc drive.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and successfully reading a disc.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift, button failure, or battery issues.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus and select options.

proof_requests: Photo of the sticker on the back of the console showing the model and serial number.
Photo of the console's system information screen showing the serial number and PSN status.
Video of the console booting to the home screen and reading a disc.
Video of the controller being used to navigate menus.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
